title: Factory Audit — Request a Quotation
purpose: Source-documented only. The original Help Center describes how to request a factory audit quotation, confirm a booking, and open the report and invoice. This article was last edited on 2024-04-02 and was not updated in November 2026. It is not confirmed on the current QMAS dev site. There is no published guide page and no reviewed screenshot.
meta: How To Request Quotation For Factory Audit From Global Laboratories
None. Unreviewed Help Center images are not included.
overview: The Help Center says: “The QMAS Factory Audit Process Management Module lets you execute and monitor your factory audit workflow online.”
The 2024 article covers a quotation, booking confirmation, progress, the report, and invoices.
Getting Started Attention cards already name **Factory Audit**, but the exact current path was not re-opened on dev.

body: These labels are Help Center text from 2024. Confirm them on dev before treating them as the current buttons.

olist: In the left menu, go to **Factory Audit** and click **Create Factory Audit Order**.
Fill out **Factory info** and contact person information, then click **Submit**.

steps.h: 2. Receive a quotation and confirm the booking
body: The Help Center says to return to **Factory Audit List** “at the top menu bar”. That top-menu wording is likely outdated. Confirm whether the list is in the left menu.

olist: After submit, job status is **Under Review**.
When the request is approved, status becomes **Waiting for Quote**.
When quotes are ready, status becomes **Quote Available**.
Click **Accept Quotes** to confirm the booking.
After accepting the quotation, status becomes **Waiting for reserve booking**.
When the booking is confirmed, status becomes **Booking Reserved**.
When the audit is completed, status becomes **Completed**.

body: The Help Center source has typographical errors (“you quotes”, “you job status swill change”). Those are not treated as UI labels.

olist: Click **View Detail** next to the job status.
Open the **REPORT** tab to view the audit report.

tips: Do not copy Help Center screenshots into this public draft. They were not privacy-reviewed.
Before anyone calls these labels current, check the left-nav name, the create button, the status names, **Accept Quotes**, and whether Quotes, Report, and Invoices tabs still exist.
